st_liens.name: Passage des Prises
st_liens.alt: A sunny summer lakeside promenade in the park, painted in ink and gouache, with a wooden footbridge across the lake in the distance: Monsieur Verbe the mime, in spiky crampons, clings to a lamp post with his hand mirror swinging from his wrist, taps a magic wand to join a broken teacup back together, plugs a cable into a socket on a tree so its lantern lights up, holds a plank to link the stepping stones of a pond while a duck waits, waves at a smiling face on a laptop at a café table and bows with a silver tray of blank gold-edged invitations. The wrought-iron gate in the stone archway on the left leads back to the park; the rose-covered trellis arch and the white garden gate in the hedge on the right lead on.

doors.label: Rue des Colocataires
doors.hint: Through the white garden gate in the hedge

lambris.name: Allée des Lambris
lambris.alt: A sunny summer alley of wood-panelled cabins and boathouses by the lake, painted in ink and gouache: Monsieur Verbe the mime waters the saplings he is planting on a bare mound, friendly green boas coiled round them, points at a black paper silhouette of his own profile on an easel, points as a museum guide at a blank framed plaque on a cabin wall, sets a big friendly spider in the centre of a rope web, points at a second blank framed plaque on a boathouse wall and opens a row of boxes with a bone in every one while a dog watches. The rose-covered trellis arch with the iron gate on the left leads back to the promenade.

doors.label: Passage des Prises
doors.hint: Back through the rose-covered trellis arch

colocataires.name: Rue des Colocataires
colocataires.alt: A sunny summer street of striped beach huts by the lake, painted in ink and gouache, with a sailing boat on the water: Monsieur Verbe the mime ties two copper pipes together with a cord, mouths a big round O with an arty parrot in a beret on his finger, carries a long log together with a beaver in a red collar, waves from the doorway of a beach hut he shares with a cow at the window and a bee on the roof, hands bread from his souvenir stall to a mother duck and her ducklings and, with a prawn on his shoulder and his hand mirror in his hand, falls in love as little hearts float up. The white garden gate between the stone pillars on the left leads back to the promenade.

doors.label: Passage des Prises
doors.hint: Back through the white garden gate
